title: This Couple Beat the Lottery… Legally 🎟️ #shorts
description:
Jerry and Marge Selbee, a retired couple from Michigan, noticed that in 'roll-down' weeks of the Winfall lottery a ticket was worth more than it cost. Buying in bulk on those draws, they won about $26 million in prizes over nine years - around $8 million profit. It was legal; the games were later ended.
